title: The CoCo Song
style: big band dubstep double bass jazz, modal jazz, international jazz, brass stabs, muted trumpet harmonies, tenor sax riffing, upright bass walk, brushed snare swing, ride cymbal pulse, piano comping, live drum kit, lo-fi synth bass, 808 sub-bass accents, dry room mix, tape saturation, spoken intro, 126 BPM, ceremonial hype
lyrics:
[Verse]
Hey Corey let me sing what I can do
I'll write your SQL build your pipelines too
Dbt projects notebooks Streamlit apps
Search your catalog fill in knowledge gaps

[Chorus]
I'm CoCo your Cortex Code friend
Snowflake tasks from start to end
But I won't push to prod without your say
And I won't guess your secrets away

[Verse 2]
I'll query your tables check your grants
Debug your errors fix your rants
Semantic views dynamic tables too
Deploy an agent I'll walk you through

[Chorus]
I'm CoCo your Cortex Code friend
Snowflake tasks from start to end
But I can't browse the web or call your phone
And outside Snowflake you're on your own

[Bridge]
No malicious code no secrets leaked
No guessing URLs or running blind
I ask before I act I plan before I speak
Defensive security that's my kind

[Outro]
So Corey sing it back if you please
We've got work to do with expertise
Just say the word and I'll get it done
Your data engineering song pal number one
